verdict.rationale: BigQuery explicitly supports querying open table formats (Iceberg, Delta, Hudi) and files in object storage without ingesting them into proprietary storage — Iceberg managed tables store data in customer-owned buckets with schema evolution and time travel, and BigQuery natively supports open table formats per its intro docs. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of querying Delta/Parquet files directly (only Iceberg is detailed with specifics), and no community corroboration of external-table performance/limitations for these formats.
